passive.descEnRank1:
Grants 12% All-Attribute DMG Bonus. Casting Intro Skill or gaining a Shield as the active Resonator grants 1 stack of Nature's Order and 1 stack of Cradle of Life. This effect can be triggered via gaining a Shield once every 0.5s, stacking up to 6 {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=1}, lasting for 7s. Switching to another Resonator ends both Nature's Order and Cradle of Life immediately.
Nature's Order: Crit. DMG is increased by 4%, up to 24%. When Nature's Order reaches 6 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=A}, the Crit. Rate of Heavy Attack DMG is increased by 12%.
Cradle of Life: Casting Heavy Attack consumes up to 2 stacks of Cradle of Life. For every 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=6} of Cradle of Life consumed, Heavy Attack DMG ignores 15% of the target's DEF, up to 30%. The effect lasts for 2s.
